name: Final-year student seeking a first developer role

searches_run.query: graduate software developer jobs UK no experience
searches_run.observation: The combined retrieval included Indeed, LinkedIn and Glassdoor job landing pages and older employer vacancy PDFs. The directly opened Indeed page labelled for graduate/no-experience searches included lead and principal roles and an embedded role requiring commercial delivery experience. This is a concrete relevance mismatch in that retrieved page, not a measurement of the whole market.

searches_run.query: how to track software engineering graduate scheme deadlines UK alerts
searches_run.observation: The retrieval surfaced Gradbeam and a Trackr technology tracker. Gradbeam explicitly markets opening notifications, application tracking and deadline reminders; its inspected tracker page distinguishes free tracking from paid alert/reminder features. Trackr retrieval showed opening and closing-date columns, including blank dates.

sources.title: Software Engineering Graduate No Experience Jobs | Indeed UK
sources.supports: Directly inspected page contains senior roles and a commercial-experience requirement despite its no-experience search heading; supports concern about keyword-result relevance only.

sources.title: No Experience Software Developer jobs in United Kingdom | LinkedIn
sources.supports: Retrieved page offers job-alert creation and includes graduate role titles; counts and eligibility were not validated.

sources.title: Free job application tracker for UK students | Gradbeam
sources.supports: Directly inspected product page advertises a free tracker for students and graduates, plus paid instant alerts and scheduled reminders. This is a vendor claim, not tested performance.

sources.title: UK Tech Tracker | Trackr
sources.supports: Retrieved technology tracker shows opening/closing dates and notification entry point. Some dates were blank and the returned tab content included internships; graduate coverage was not independently verified.

best_entry_page.primary_query: graduate software developer jobs UK no experience
best_entry_page.promise: A practical guide to finding first developer roles, reading commercial-experience requirements, and building a shortlist of covered UK employers to follow for new openings. Distinguish graduate programmes from general junior vacancies and tell readers to verify intake dates and deadlines on employer pages.
best_entry_page.cta: Search graduate and junior developer openings free, then save suitable companies and criteria for email alerts.
proof_needed: Verified UK graduate-employer coverage with original careers links and a stated review date
Examples of source requirements that distinguish academic projects from required commercial experience
Demonstrated free search, alerts and tracker flow, with the ten-watchlist limit explained
Clear separation between new-posting alerts and deadline reminders, which are not demonstrated Job Seek functionality
Evidence that employer and role filters yield a useful number of genuinely relevant first-job options before publishing the guide

conversion_objections: Will a junior filter still send jobs requiring three years of experience?
I do not yet know which companies to follow; making a shortlist feels like the hard part.
Will alerts cover my target graduate schemes, including employers missing from the service?
Can I get useful alerts without paying $10 per month?
Does this remind me before closing dates, or only when new jobs appear?
Why move from LinkedIn alerts or a graduate-specific tracker if I already use a spreadsheet?

avoid_targeting.query: guaranteed software developer job no experience UK
avoid_targeting.reason: No product can guarantee hiring or eligibility; this promise would mislead.
Do not position Job Seek as a deadline reminder tool until that capability and reliable deadline data are demonstrated.
CV creation is outside demonstrated functionality.

avoid_targeting.query: all 2027 software graduate schemes open now
avoid_targeting.reason: Exhaustive coverage and live programme status are unverified; avoid an all-employers or guaranteed-current promise.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I need to find companies willing to consider university projects instead of professional experience, and I do not know enough companies to build a useful list myself. Show me a few believable examples before asking me to sign up, make the free alerts easy to understand, and be clear if closing-date reminders are something I still need to manage elsewhere.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, not an interview or observed user session. Two representative searches and two direct page inspections on 2026-09-28 support relevance and alternative-tool observations only. The remaining queries are hypotheses. Retrieval was combined, so source grouping reflects content relevance rather than isolated per-query ranking. No keyword volumes, ranking difficulty, conversion rates or population-wide claims are inferred. Job availability, graduate intake, employer coverage and competitor functionality require fresh verification. Product fit follows the supplied repository brief; proposed guide is not an existing indexed page.
